{{Quote|Mr. Nesdin, while Mr. Talkpha is so engaged please contact our next scheduled stop and advise that we will be delayed by a priority courier mission. Then get us moving to Corellia.''"<br />"''Yes, ma'am.|Mara Jade and Nesdin|<ref name="Ambush at Corellia">''[[Ambush at Corellia]]''</ref>}}
'''Nesdin''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]]. He was the pilot of the ship ''[[Jade's Fire]]''. After the resolution of the [[Corellian Crisis|First Corellian Insurrection]], [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] surmised that he was most likely dead, but hoped there was a chance he had only been captured or had hidden on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].
